failures: invalid game, zero candidate credit, no win, block promotion; no retries or fallback

timing.scope: whole agent decision including observation, conversion, inference/search and selection; excludes opponent and authoritative execute
timing.cold: initialization plus first nonforced decision separately per game/seat
timing.overrun: every decision greater than budget logged
timing.execution: serial with exclusive harness lock; no competing accelerator jobs

baseline_heuristic: Framework base_fn weights, independent sampled futures, neutral hidden dev draw; diagnostic variant, no authoritative future RNG/deck
